subject: Double charge on card
body: We were charged twice for the monthly subscription.
resolution: Confirmed a duplicate charge caused by a payment-gateway retry. Refunded the second charge (5-7 business days) and sent the refund receipt.

subject: Invoice needs VAT ID
body: Our invoice is missing our VAT number.
resolution: Added the VAT ID under Settings > Billing > Tax details, regenerated the invoice and emailed the PDF. Future invoices include it automatically.

subject: Price increased without notice
body: Our plan price went up this month.
resolution: Explained the legacy-plan migration announced by email 60 days earlier and applied a one-month courtesy credit for the difference.

subject: Bought too many seats
body: We purchased seats we don't need.
resolution: Removed the unused seats; the unused portion was credited to the account balance (prorated) rather than refunded to card.

subject: Seat count not updated after upgrade
body: Upgraded plan but seats still show the old number.
resolution: Plan changes sync within 5 minutes; a stuck sync was re-triggered from the billing admin and invites started working.

subject: Pay by bank transfer
body: Can we pay by bank transfer instead of card?
resolution: Bank transfer and invoicing are available on annual Business plans; card and PayPal on all plans.

subject: Password reset email not received
body: Reset emails never arrive.
resolution: The customer's mail server rejected our sender. Asked them to allowlist our mail domain, then sent a manual reset link valid for 30 minutes.

subject: Add read-only teammate
body: How to give someone view-only access?
resolution: Settings > Team > Invite, choose the 'Viewer' role. Viewers can open dashboards and reports but cannot edit or export.

subject: Suspicious API keys and logins
body: API keys we did not create appeared on our account.
resolution: Revoked all API keys, forced logout of all sessions, required a password reset and enforced 2FA. Security reviewed audit logs within 24h.

subject: Request for DPA and sub-processors
body: Legal needs our data processing agreement.
resolution: Shared the signed DPA template and the sub-processor list from the trust center; countersigned within 3 business days.

subject: Dashboard returning 500 errors
body: All dashboards show server error 500.
resolution: Linked to the incident on the status page (database failover). Resolved in 47 minutes; the customer received the incident report.

subject: CSV import date error on large file
body: Import fails with invalid date format on big files.
resolution: Chunked imports lost the header row after 1,000 rows. Fixed in 4.12; workaround was importing files under 1,000 rows.

subject: Webhooks arriving late
body: Webhook events delayed by many minutes.
resolution: Queue backlog after a deploy; workers were scaled and delays returned to under 5 seconds. Failed deliveries replayed automatically.

subject: Scheduled report PDFs are blank
body: Scheduled emails contain empty PDFs.
resolution: PDF renderer regression; engineering rolled back the renderer and re-sent the affected reports.

subject: Search fails with special characters
body: Searching for names with an apostrophe returns nothing.
resolution: The query parser didn't escape apostrophes; fixed in 4.9. Workaround: search for the part after the apostrophe.

subject: Mobile app crash after update
body: Android app closes on launch after update.
resolution: Crash in the push-notification SDK on some Android versions. Hotfix 3.8.1 shipped the same day via the Play Store.

subject: Slack connect popup blank
body: OAuth popup for Slack is empty.
resolution: Third-party cookie blocking broke the OAuth popup; switched to a redirect flow in 4.11. Workaround: allow third-party cookies for our domain.

subject: Okta SSO support
body: Do you support SAML SSO with Okta?
resolution: SAML SSO (Okta, Azure AD, Google) is available on Business and above. Shared the setup guide.

subject: Dark mode request
body: Please add a dark theme.
resolution: Logged the vote on the public roadmap item 'Dark mode' (planned for Q1). Customer subscribed to updates.

subject: Schedule exports to cloud storage
body: Can exports be scheduled to Google Drive?
resolution: Not native yet; logged on the roadmap. Workaround: scheduled export email plus the Zapier integration into Google Drive.

subject: Agency partner program
body: Do you work with agencies or resellers?
resolution: Shared the partner programme page (20% recurring commission) and connected them with the partnerships team.
